title: Starting Block
author: Nathan White
desc: Build an Athletic look with an hourglass shape. Also to get legs and joints lubricated for future workout blocks.

ex.note: Keep feet low on platform, close together to put focus on Quads.
Lean back in seat. Do not have back straight up. Leaning back puts more emphasis on Rectus Femoris which gives quads lots of definition and shape.
Hardest Part of Exercise, keep foot in middle of plat form but Straight with torso. This makes it equal distribution.
10 steps back and forth 2 times. keep it light. This is mostly to get hips lubricated for upcoming workouts.
Just two sets. Knees to chest try to focus on bottom part of Abs.
Just two sets. Try to Crunch top part of Abs.

ss.note: Main Workout, drive Hips up and squeeze Glutes to maximize Glute activation.
Put Band Around neck and step on it with both legs, then perform RDL motion focusing on stretching Hamstrings. Mostly a mobility exercise.

ex.note: Use Cable ropes and put through and thrust hips forward squeezing Glutes.
Just one set to keep arms tight and endurance.
One set, Use the inside grip to focus on front shoulders and triceps. this helps avoid a wider bulky look.
